intro: 26.7 will be cut directly off master. This is everything merged since 26.6.0 was tagged, minus the patch and the release commits.

native.baseline: 26.6.0 tag, 6 June (merge-base of master and release/26.6)
native.note: release/26.6 is what is in production: master at the cut plus the 26.6.1 backport. App store approval is not visible in git, so the published GitHub release is the strongest in-repo signal.

web.next: web/26.7.0, tagged off master when ready
web.baseline: web/26.6.0, 5 June (newest web tag that is on master)
web.in_window: 16 user-facing web PRs merged to master
web.note: web/26.6.1 and web/26.6.2 are cherry-pick lineages, each carrying one feature-flag flip. app.fedi.xyz serves /api/features to both apps, so a flag deploy is a web deploy. They are not the baseline; web/26.6.0 is.

backport.headline: Patch 26.6.1 is going out first with 2 fixes, and those are not counted here.
backport.note: PR #11593 cherry-picks these onto release/26.6. They are on master too, but they reach users as the patch rather than as part of 26.7.

summary.title: Group chats you can ask to join, emoji reactions, and a nudge to back up your wallet
summary.lede: The web app catches up on chat: reactions, message actions and requesting to join a private group. The native app gets a backup reminder and a run of crash and layout fixes.

features.headline: Request to join private and community groups
features.summary: People will be able to ask to join a private group, and admins can review those requests.

features.headline: Personal backup reminder
features.summary: A reminder that nudges people to back up their wallet. Built and ready, held behind a feature flag.

fixes.headline: Send button greys out when funds are short
fixes.summary: The confirm button is disabled when the balance is too low.

fixes.headline: Crash fix for older iPhones (iOS 15)
fixes.summary: A fix is in review and not yet on master.

planned_keep.title: Separate history entries for reused on-chain addresses
planned_keep.detail: Each deposit to a reused address gets its own line in history.

issues.title: Sent messages displayed again as drafts

needs_milestone.title: Implement knocking / request to join a group chat
On iPhone, Fedi sends you to the Settings app
